title: MemoryReflectionsGenerateResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "reflection_id": string, "cost": { "units": number, "unit_kind": string }? }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.reflections.generate (§7.27): PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, REVISION_CONFLICT, NOT_AUTHORIZED, SPACE_FROZEN, SUBJECT_FENCED, OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
